title: Pakistan KP Province Emergency Rule Update — Oct 25, 2026
summary: KP Governor Faisal Karim Kundi ruled out talks with groups that reject the Constitution on Oct 24, after a CTD DSP and a constable were killed in a Karak operation. He said the Centre would supply police with weapons and funds, and cited a Rs160 billion federal package for the province. The Peshawar High Court hearing remains adjourned to Nov 10.

title: Pakistan KP Province Emergency Rule Update — Sat Oct 24, 2026
summary: Governor Faisal Karim Kundi said there would be no negotiations or concessions for groups that do not accept the Constitution, and that decisive action against terrorism is the way to restore peace.

title: Pakistan KP Province Emergency Rule Update — Oct 23, 2026
summary: The Peshawar High Court issued notices on Oct 20 to the federal and KP governments on petitions challenging the emergency and governor's rule, and adjourned the hearing to Nov 10. Petitioners argue provincial assembly approval was required. No interim order was reported.

title: Pakistan KP Province Emergency Rule Update — Tue Oct 20, 2026
summary: PHC issues notices on KP governor's rule petitions, adjourns to Nov 10.

title: Pakistan KP Province Emergency Rule Update — Oct 18, 2026
summary: A joint sitting of Parliament ratified the emergency and governor's rule in KP for two months on Oct 15, after both houses endorsed them separately. The opposition TTAP alliance called off talks with the government. PTI and allied petitions were filed at the Peshawar High Court, which set Oct 20 for the first hearing.
